title: Organiser dashboard — visual world
question: The roll assigned Match Day Programme. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Match Day Programme
options.thesis: Your hub reads like the official programme handed out at the gate—fixtures, stats, and sales as printed listings inside a folded card.
options.viewport: Programme cover with organiser name and today's date stamp; inside fold shows KPI stat boxes, weekly attendance grid, and numbered fixture rows with court and fill counts.
options.risk: Feels static if the fold metaphor never earns its keep on mobile scroll.

options.label: Night Instrument Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six trusted dials hold the organiser's truth through cloud—sales, tickets, views, conversion cross-checked in one sweep.
options.case: Strongest product clarity: each KPI is a gauge with trend needle, not a number in a card.
options.viewport: Matte black panel with six round gauges in two rows; amber caution lamp only on low conversion; upcoming events as terse placard list beneath.
options.risk: Aviation metaphor may feel distant from grassroots community sport.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.thesis: Giant cropped session names on color fields—panorama swipe between sales, chart, and fixtures with zero chrome.
options.case: Strongest mobile identification: between-session glance reads one tile at poster scale.
options.viewport: Black ground with cyan sales tile dominating left third; lime chart tile and white fixtures tile peek from the right edge of a horizontal panorama.
options.risk: Bold type can bury honest metric labels if density isn't disciplined.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.thesis: Side A lists this week's sessions with running times; Side B holds quick links—timed like a forty-five-minute tape.
options.case: Fuses poorly: sequential Side A/B flip fights an always-on dashboard glance.
options.viewport: Folded j-card with handwritten block caps; tracklist rows for upcoming events with right-aligned times; KPI totals inked in the margin.
options.risk: Handwritten metaphor can read playful when organisers need sober numbers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Four KPI cards, bar chart, event list, quick-nav strip—the arrangement every organiser tool ships.
canonCard.viewport: Grey canvas with four-up metric row, chart left and event panel right, bottom quick links—current Honest Clubhouse tokens.
canonCard.risk: Safe and familiar; may not earn a second look from organisers who live in spreadsheets.
